title: fix(mcp): run a stdio generate on a worker thread and honour cancel
body:
## What changed
- `camcraft-cli mcp` (the stdio server) runs a `generate` call on a worker thread. A new module, `crates/app/src/mcp/background.rs`, holds the lane.
- A reader thread moves the input lines through a channel with capacity one. The session thread keeps the world.
- The session stages each operation on its own thread (`StagedGeneration`, #2257). A worker thread runs the pure finish.
- Other calls answer while the worker runs, for example `get_job` and `save_project`. The generate answer goes out when its result lands. Answers can come out of request order. JSON-RPC permits this.
- A result lands through the History only if `still_current` is true. If the operation or its cached path changed during the run, the call is refused by name. The GUI worker uses the same rule.
- `notifications/cancelled` with the generate's `requestId` drops the generate result. The cancelled worker keeps its slot until it finishes. No answer goes out for that id.
- A second `generate` while one runs is refused by name, including after cancellation until its worker finishes. `open_project` is refused while a generate runs, because it replaces the world.
- At the end of input, a running generate still gets its answer.
- `script::api::generate_targets` is now shared by the script verb and the MCP lane, so the two paths run the same operations.
- The live GUI bridge and `Server::handle` stay synchronous.
- `cli.rs` gives `serve` a `BufReader` over `stdin()`, because the reader thread needs a `Send` handle.

## Cause
`mcp::serve` handled each line on one thread. `generate` ran the generator in the call, so the loop read no input until the generator ended. The protocol had no cancel path.

## Tests

The `mcp` directory suite includes the three original pins and four review pins.
The hidden `Server::hold_generations` hook holds a worker until the test releases it.
The final-head validation below records the commands, mutation proofs, and results.

## Goldens moved
None. The change does not touch a generator or a post. `example_catalog` ran in the quick gate and passed with no change.

## Heavy lanes
The final-head review round below records the full reached heavy run requested by the maintainer.

## Not exercised
- A generic blocking reader cannot be interrupted. After an output error, its owned thread can wait for input or EOF. It retains no session or world.
- The real `camcraft-cli mcp` binary over a pipe with a slow job. The QA project (mould core) is not on this machine. The pins drive `mcp::serve_with` in-process with the same loop.
- A real stop inside a generator. A cancelled worker runs to its end, and the session drops its result.
- The staging of a rest operation still simulates the operations ahead of it on the session thread. That part still blocks other calls.

## Still open on #3035
- The run time of Rough12, Rest6 and Waterline6 on the mould core.
- A cancel point inside the generators.

## Overlaps
None. No open PR changes `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs`, `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` or `crates/app/src/commands/operation/generate.rs`.

Decision record: `docs/decisions/3035-mcp-generate-worker.md`.


## Review fix round on c83ab4889bc8455306a74827b6c6f9a13e3ba308

The round addresses the four findings on head `91e412fdcb44ceee7a9d743b599c90cac24605c6`.

1. A cancelled worker retains the single worker slot until completion. Repeated retries receive the busy refusal.
   Pin: `background_generate::cancelled_workers_keep_the_worker_budget_until_they_finish`.
2. The event channel has capacity one. Input stops reading when the queue and pending line are full.
   Pin: `background_streams::blocked_output_bounds_the_input_queue`.
3. `name: null` takes the background path. Dispatch accepts the same non-null IDs as the synchronous handler.
   Pin: `background_generate::a_null_name_uses_the_background_lane_and_busy_guard`.
4. The input thread owns its reader. An output error returns without joining a blocked reader.
   Pin: `background_streams::an_output_error_returns_while_input_remains_open`.

### Pin proof

`CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo test -j 12 -p camcraft-app --test mcp background_ -- --test-threads=1` passed all seven background tests.

Each mutation failed its named pin. Restoring the fix passed the same pin:

- Drop the cancelled worker slot: the retry starts another held worker. RED, then GREEN.
- Increase the event channel capacity to 1,000: the reader consumes more than three lines while output blocks. RED, then GREEN.
- Remove null-name normalization: the held generate answers synchronously. RED, then GREEN.
- Restore the narrower ID dispatch: an accepted boolean ID bypasses the busy guard. RED, then GREEN.
- Join the input reader after an output error: `serve` does not return before input closes. RED, then GREEN.

The mutation checks ran before the commit. The final-head MCP suite runs the restored source.

### Final-head validation

Base: current `upstream/main`, `29488d99c9cdbe32b689f7c0d6d70d8361ef85d7`.

- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=12 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN. 169 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 14.2 minutes.
- The quick gate includes `mcp`: 43 passed. All seven background pins pass on this head.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.
- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=12 cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: RED. 64 steps, 1 failed, 0 stalled; 28.2 minutes. The plan reaches 63 heavy steps plus the release build.
- The heavy failure is `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`, test `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`. At `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:79`, the imported mesh has 5,232 facets; the Linux pin expects 6,228. It fails before generation. This round changes no fixture or importer. The failure is outside the four requested MCP findings and is left unchanged.
- The failing test and its STEP fixture have identical Git blobs at the reviewed head, this head, and current `upstream/main`:
  - `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs`: `337b27c493810c9ba3f9e68f46ce6c851e1eb6c7`.
  - `testdata/models/Milling-test.step`: `bb4110f4946759a875a71d8387b1c13761c9b28a`.
- The existing known-fail checks for #1950, #2849 and #3825 failed as expected and passed their gate checks.
- The final working tree is clean. HEAD and the base ref did not change during these final-head checks.

The first quick attempt had a generated-cache fault after automatic target seeding: E0463 on internal crates. Cleaning those package artifacts and disabling seeding repaired it. No source change was required.

Goldens moved: none. `example_catalog` passed (39 passed, 4 ignored), and `first_part_programs` passed (2 passed). No recorded program changed.

No UI file changed. Screenshots are not required. No screenshot, log, or review evidence file is in the branch.

## Review fix round on 07e37adeb7a82b1bda741f8003251300db15a291

This round fixes the retained-entity crash from the latest review of `c83ab4889`.
The background lane keeps operation names only. It resolves each entity when it uses the operation.
It skips a queued operation after deletion or undo of its creation.
After History execution, it resolves the current name again before it reads the operation view.
A missing current operation gives a refusal. The `still_current` guard remains before History execution.

### Pin proof

- `background_generate::a_deleted_queued_operation_is_skipped`
- `background_generate::an_undone_queued_add_is_skipped`

Each pin failed with SIGABRT when the reviewed source replaced the fix.
Restoring the fix passed all nine background tests.

### Final-head validation

Head: `07e37adeb7a82b1bda741f8003251300db15a291`.
Base: current `upstream/main`. `16115cd06a3694dfadaa57876c050e6d83c8faab`

- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=12 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN. 169 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 15.6 minutes.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -j 12 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.
- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=12 cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'`: GREEN. 5 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 5.3 minutes. All 11 tests passed.
- `CAMCRAFT_NO_SEED=1 CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=12 cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: RED. 64 steps, 1 failed, 0 stalled; 17.9 minutes.
  One observed failure is `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`, test `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`.
  At `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:157`, the macOS pin expects `(3158, 3130, 1141)` and receives `(4688, 4660, 1980)`.
  The Linux-only mesh assertion is skipped on this host. This round leaves the test and fixture unchanged.
  Their blobs match current `upstream/main`: test `337b27c493810c9ba3f9e68f46ce6c851e1eb6c7`; fixture `bb4110f4946759a875a71d8387b1c13761c9b28a`.
  No separate baseline run was performed.
- The quick gate ran `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored. It also ran `first_part_programs`: 2 passed, and the `adaptive_trochoid` golden suite: 12 passed.

Goldens moved: none. The catalog and reached golden suites passed. No recorded program changed. The working tree is clean.

No UI file changed. Screenshots are not required.
This round does not exercise a generator cancellation point or the real CLI with the mould-core project.
The earlier limitations still apply.
The warm worktree remains in place. No screenshot, log, or review evidence is committed.

Changelog: camcraft-cli mcp runs a generate on a worker thread: get_job and save_project answer while it runs, and notifications/cancelled drops it.

Refs #3035
